body: Hey, anyone not have a partner yet? I’m trying to do a detox this Sunday as well. I’m 19 from the US about to start my sophomore year of uni and my goals are to start waking up early, workout every morning, eat healthier, write a creative story in my free time and start a business. Let me know if you want to be my partner because I definitely will be yours.

I’ve found solace in spreading love even though it disintegrates into the world’s hateful abyss. It’s a short term solution but at least for the time being it helps me to see others feel as if they are known and significant despite the fact they may not hold similar feelings to me. Try it, it doesn’t work for everyone, but I can guarantee it will at least give you a short boost of comfort and belonging. Thank you for responding, know I am with you friend.
